title: Regional priority fallback controller and adaptive error-signal sensors
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a regional-priority fallback controller that consumes multi-signal health sensors (429 spikes, request timeouts, backend error-rate, p95/p99 latency drift, and model-variant quality checks) and triggers automated, graded fallbacks and circuit-breaker actions per route-tier-region. Goal: keep high-tier routes online with minimal quality regression while preventing cascade failures across regions and tiers.
acceptance_criteria: Controller produces a single composite health score per (route, region, tier) and exposes it via /internal/health-scores API
Soft-fallbacks (route->compatible lower-cost model variant) activate automatically on transient 429/timeout spikes and revert after hysteresis window without operator action
Hard-circuit-breaker trips when sustained error-rate or latency exceeds configured SLO-derived thresholds for the defined window and stays tripped until cooldown + manual confirmation option
All fallback and CB actions are recorded as events in the routing audit log, visible in Console rollout views with links to the cause signals
Automated canary validation runs for candidate fallback model variants (10 requests/min for 5 minutes) and failure of canary blocks fallback promotion
Dashboard shows health-score decomposition (error-rate, 429-rate, timeout-rate, p95 drift) and the topology of affected routes; alerting rules fire at same thresholds used by controller
Integration tests covering simulated spike scenarios (429 storms, sudden regional SLO violations, model variant regressions) pass in CI with deterministic outcomes
steps: Prototype composite scoring function and document formula in Confluence
Add lightweight sensors that emit 429/timeouts/error counts and p95 windows to the routing metrics stream
Implement controller with EMA-based scoring, hysteresis, and cooldown state machine
Wire controller into smart-router to perform soft-fallback, hard-circuit-breaker, and to call autoscaler hint endpoint
Add canary-validation harness for fallback model variants
Add Console UI hooks: timeline events, per-route health breakdown, and action buttons for manual override
Create integration test suite and run against staging chaos scenarios
Ship with feature-flag rollout to 10% of customers then ramp based on stability signals
progress_updates: 2026-03-05: Created ticket; initial design sketched during infra sync. Decided to favour composite scoring over single-metric thresholds to reduce false positives.

2026-03-07: Prototype of scoring function checked in: uses 60s EMA for short signal and 10m EMA for sustained signal. Confluence doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Regional+Fallback+Controller
2026-03-09: Added sensor telemetry ingestion pipeline changes (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/432). Sensors emit tags for route, region, tier, model-variant.
2026-03-11: Controller PoC in runtime branch runtime/fallback-controller. Internal review found need for canary validation to avoid quality regressions when throttling to quantized variants.

2026-03-12: End-to-end test harness implemented for simulated 429 storm; soft-fallback triggered and automatically reverted after recovery in staging. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8421
decisions: Use composite health score (weighted sum of normalized signals) rather than separate independent thresholds to reduce oscillation when a single metric has noisy spikes.

Implement soft-fallback vs hard-circuit-breaker dichotomy: soft falls back to compatible model variant and remains reversible; hard trips block traffic and require cooldown + optional manual confirmation.
Estimate weights: 429-rate (0.35), timeout-rate (0.30), error-rate (0.20), latency-drift (0.10), canary-failure-penalty (0.05) — weights are tunable via config per project.
Controller will signal autoscaler via hints (not direct scale commands) to preserve separation of concerns; autoscaler will prioritize adding capacity for high-tier routes flagged by controller.
Cooldown and hysteresis windows default: soft hysteresis 60s, soft cooldown 3m; hard window 5m sustained, hard cooldown 30m. Tunable per-route in config.
